m: The {Lifeguard} creeps up the {Staircase} of the {Youth Hostel} holding a *tattooed blade* covered in pictures of skulls and dragons. She is hunting the mosquito that kept everyone awake all night. She swings, misses, swings again, and finally manages **to kill** it with a mighty whack. The backpackers cheer, then realise the whack was strong enough **to kill** the bunk bed too.

The {Dentist} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Pool} past a *market stall* selling books by the kilo. Every page lets out a *small speech bubble* that chatters its words aloud. He buys a whole cartload and sits on the diving board **to read**, but the books talk so fast he must **read** with earplugs in.

The {Ghost} floats onto the {Rooftop} of the {Spa} and taps a dozing *auntie* in a face mask on the shoulder. Her enormous *mouth* opens wide: **ah**! **Ahhh**! The scream blows the cucumber slices off her eyes, and every guest in the spa yells **ah** in reply, a full choir of fright.

The {Chef} sprints across the {Rooftop} of the {Tower} with a soufflé, chased by a *runner* and a *town crier* ringing his bell. The crier yells that the Chef is losing, so the Chef straps rockets to his clogs **to overtake** them both. He zooms past the runner, past the crier, and even manages **to overtake** a passing pigeon.

The {Magician} sneaks into the {Basement} of the {Yen Exchange}, where a sly *dodger* is ducking under the tax collector's desk. The Magician waves his wand and the dodger's bill vanishes with a puff: he is **exempt**! Everyone in the queue wants **to exempt** themselves too, and starts crawling under the desk.

The {Yogi} balances on the {Rooftop} of the {Spa} under a towering *cliff*, holding a single *clod* of earth in his palm. A boulder rolls off the cliff and he catches it, then **presses** it flat like a pancake. He uses it **to press** the guests' towels, and soon the whole spa smells of hot stone.

The {Yogi} tiptoes up the {Staircase} of the {Inn} carrying a tray of *gold coins*. The innkeeper gives them such a frosty *glare* that the gold turns pale, chilly and shiny: they are now **silver**. Even the Yogi's beard turns **silver**, and the guests pay with icicles.

The {Magician} digs his way into the {Basement} of the {Island} with an enormous *shopping basket*. He wants **to buy** everything: coconuts, crabs, the volcano, the sea. He pays with rabbits pulled from his hat, and the shopkeeper parrot squawks: **buy** more, buy more, until the basket floats off the island.

The {Hunter} wades up the {Staircase} of the {Swamp} and finds a frog sitting in a *golden crown* bigger than itself. Every alligator bows. This frog is the **emperor** of the swamp, and he croaks orders through a reed. The Hunter kneels in the mud, and the **emperor** knights him with a dragonfly.

The {Yogi} creeps into the {Basement} of the {Hangar} and finds a lamb, a goat and a baby jet plane all crying for milk. He decides **to raise** them all. He bottle-feeds the plane jet fuel, sings to the lamb, and when they're grown he has **raised** a goat that can fly.

The {Yogi} meditates on the {Rooftop} of the {Beach} hut when a *standing person* in a long robe climbs up beside him: a *magistrate*. The magistrate bows and recites an ancient poem to him: O **you**, O thou, who sits so still. The Yogi bows back and replies with the same old-fashioned **you**, and the seagulls clap.

The {Hunter} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Wine Cellar} cradling a baby barrel in his **bosom**. His *standing heart* thumps with love. A *no sign* swings in front of him: no barrels upstairs! He just hugs it tighter to his **bosom** and refuses to let go.

The {Jockey} gallops up the {Staircase} of the {Beehive}, and a bee clamps a pair of *handcuffs* onto his wrist. They chain him to a honeycomb, so he must **grasp** it with both hands, sticky and dripping. Every jockey who visits must **grasp** the comb, and nobody can let go.

The {Firefighter} crashes through the {Trapdoor} of the {Pool} and finds a *full jar* of jam being sliced by a *standing knife*. The first piece goes to the chief: the **secondary** slice goes to her, the deputy. She gets the **secondary** helmet, the **secondary** boots, and the slightly smaller pool float.

The {Lifeguard} plunges through the {Trapdoor} of the {Swan Pond} on a single *ski*, and a giant *tongue* licks her off course. She crashes into the swans, the swans crash into the boats, feathers fly, paddles spin: everything is **in disorder**. The pond is **in disorder** and the swans file a complaint.

The {King} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Hangar}, and a *helping hand* tries to strip off his *high collar*. He wriggles, kicks, and fights **to resist**. Everyone in the hangar pulls, but he holds on with his teeth. The collar stays on: he can **resist** anything except a tickle.

The {Firefighter} slides through the {Trapdoor} of the {Mansion} as a *prowling dog* steals the lord's sausage. A *bowing man*, the butler, is horrified: this is bound **to offend** his lordship. The dog barks rudely. Everything it does seems designed **to offend**, and it ends up chewing the lord's wig.

The {Jockey} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Waiting Room} as a runaway taxi speeds down the *road* below. He leaps on his horse **to chase** it, galloping over the *sandbags* the builders have left. The taxi skids, the horse jumps, the passengers wave, and the Jockey keeps **chasing** it all around town.

The {Baker} perches on the {Rooftop} of the {Hangar} as a whole *country* floods with flour. He grabs a *towel* and begins wiping the mountains and rivers clean. He works night and day **to help**. The pilots join in **to help**, and soon the country shines like a freshly baked loaf.

The {Shepherd} climbs onto the {Rooftop} of the {Mint} with a gigantic *megaphone*. He wants **to announce** that every new coin will have a sheep on it. His voice booms so loud that coins jump out of their bags, and every coin begins **to announce** it too, rattling: baa!

The {Firefighter} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Fort} and finds a *standing person* who sits down crossed-legged and becomes a smiling golden **Buddha**. A *dollar sign* rains down from his halo. The soldiers try to grab the money, but the **Buddha** just smiles, and the money turns into lotus flowers.

The {Sailor} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Waiting Room} and waits by a window showing a *mountain*. A *dusk moon* rises over it, sets, rises again. Each time a candle appears on his cake: another **year of age**. By the time his name is called, he has a white beard and a cake on fire with years: ninety-one **years of age**.

The {Hunter} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Hangar} and finds a *boat* parked among the planes, wearing a captain's *high collar*. It wants **to sail**, so it raises its sails, and the wind blows it right out of the hangar door. The planes taxi behind it, and they all **sail** across the airfield.

The {Yogi} relaxes on the {Rooftop} of the {Boathouse} next to a *standing person* with a *wart* on his nose. The wart sings opera so beautifully that the boats stop rocking. It's **excellent**, the best voice on the river! The judges give it ten out of ten and a medal saying **excellent**.

The {Gardener} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Wine Cellar}, where a *saint* with a halo is juggling wine bottles. The Gardener's *standing heart* jumps. Then the bottles start singing, the barrels tap-dance, the corks fly in a circle. Everything is **strange**, very **strange**, and the saint winks.

The {Shepherd} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Stadium} lighting a giant stick of *incense*. Smoke curls over the pitch and everyone sniffs: roses, cinnamon, fresh bread. The whole stadium is **fragrant**, the players stop to sniff the **fragrant** air, and even the referee's socks smell of lavender.

The {Jockey} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Pool} into a lawn of *grass* where a *busy man* is signing autographs. He is **famous**: crowds scream, cameras flash. The Jockey asks why, and learns he's the man who mows the grass. Everyone wants to be as **famous** as him.

The {Tailor} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Yen Exchange} and finds a *rice field* growing on the trading floor. The bankers wade through it in their suits. He stitches a quilt of green squares, each one a **field**, and sells each little **field** for a fortune.

The {Tailor} creeps into the {Basement} of the {Yeti Cave}, where a *lost arrow* has hit a pile of *gold coins* and turned them grey. They're no longer gold but heavy **iron**! The yeti uses them to make an **iron** pan, and the Tailor uses the leftovers as buttons.

The {King} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Lagoon} hut into an *empty room* where a *helping hand* holds a remote. He grabs it **to control** the lagoon: waves up, waves down, fish go left. He tries **to control** the moon next, and the tide falls over.

The {Sheriff} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Waiting Room} as a *money changer* counts out the farmers' grain. He takes a *grain stalk* from every bag: that's the **tax**. The farmers grumble, so the Sheriff takes a **tax** on grumbling too.

The {Zookeeper} sneaks into the {Basement} of the {Warehouse}, where every arrow, crate and sign points *left*. He tries to walk straight but the floor turns **left**, the forklifts drive **left**, even his hat slides off to the left. He walks in circles for an hour and ends up exactly where he started.

The {Yogi} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Boathouse} where a *feeding hand* is feeding the ducks, but only on the **right**. The left ducks quack with jealousy. The Yogi raises his **right** hand too, and all the ducks swim to the right side, so the boathouse tips over.

The {Firefighter} slides through the {Trapdoor} of the {Funfair} and finds a *standing person* cutting a giant cake. Each child gets one **portion**, the clown gets one, the elephant gets one. The Firefighter asks for her **portion** and gets a slice the size of a fire engine.

The {Chef} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Swan Pond} and pokes a *fang* through the wall of a *cave*, making a neat hole. Now he can thread his clothes through it **to wear**: a sock, a sleeve, a whole coat. The swans also want something **to wear**, so he dresses them in tutus.

The {Yogi} slides through the {Trapdoor} of the {Beach} and finds a *swan* painting with its beak on a canvas of *grass*. It makes masterpieces: sunsets, portraits, spaghetti. It's **art**, real **art**, and the crabs pay a seashell each to see the gallery.

The {Baker} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Lake} house and carries the *moon* on his **back** while facing *north*. He walks so far that the moon gets heavy, bending his **back** like a croissant. He turns around and the moon sets.

The {Jockey} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Funfair}, and soldiers on a *hillside* push a *cart* into place. They arrange themselves into a **troop formation**: a triangle, a square, a dragon. The Jockey shouts orders, and the bumper cars line up in **troop formation** too.

The {Tsar} creeps into the {Basement} of the {Tower}, where *grass* grows up through the floor. An *early bird* pecks at it every morning. The **grass** grows faster than the bird can eat, up the stairs and out the windows, until the tower wears a wig of **grass**.

The {Juggler} slides into the {Basement} of the {Cat Café} under the *moon* and steps on a cat's tail. He has to *retreat* fast, hopping on one **foot**. The cats chase him, nibbling his toes, so he juggles with his **foot** to distract them.

The {Gardener} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Island} and finds a *tree* standing over a *finished meal*. He can't tell what was eaten, but he knows in **general**: coconuts. He gives a **general** report to the gulls: it was coconuts, more or less.

The {Ghost} slides through the {Trapdoor} of the {Hut} and finds a villain with a black *heart* polishing a *silver medal* he stole. He's **evil**, cackling, twirling his moustache. The Ghost spooks him so hard his **evil** laugh comes out as a hiccup.

The {King} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Wine Cellar} into a heap of *soil* and pulls out an *archer's ring*. It's stuck to a **chunk** of rock. He bites off a **chunk** of chocolate to celebrate, then drops it into the wine.

The {Dentist} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Casino} into a *camp* of gamblers reading a *page* of rules. Everyone has **to pause** while he reads it out loud. He **pauses** between every word, and the roulette wheel falls asleep.

The {Gardener} sneaks into the {Basement} of the {Mansion} with nothing but a walking *cane*. A bear is sleeping there. Who would **dare** to poke it? The Gardener does, he **dares** to tickle its nose, and the bear sneezes him out of the window.

The {Sheriff} sits in the {Basement} of the {Boathouse} under a leaky *roof*, keeping his *thumb* in a hole. He must **guard** the boats from sinking. All night he stays there **to guard** them, until his thumb turns into a prune.

The {Juggler} stumbles into the {Basement} of the {Youth Hostel} and finds *water drops* leaking from a giant *wine jug*. He tastes one: it's **wine**! He juggles cups of **wine**, the backpackers cheer, and the hostel smells like a vineyard.

The {Dentist} sneaks into the {Basement} of the {Tower} and finds a tiny *island* floating in a bathtub, palm trees and all. A pirate the size of a thumb waves from the **island**. The Dentist checks the pirate's teeth and leaves him a toothbrush on his **island**.

The {Tailor} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Warehouse} and a *helping hand* gives him a single *grass blade* to hold. It's precious, and he has **to entrust** it to someone. He hands it to a pigeon, who gives it back. Nobody wants to be **entrusted** with grass.

The {Yogi} meditates on the {Rooftop} of the {Hangar} with a wooden *yoke* across his shoulders, a bucket hanging from each end. He must stay in the exact **centre** or the buckets spill. He wobbles left, right, and finally finds the **centre**, perfectly balanced, as planes land on both sides.

The {Hunter} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Pool} and knocks on a *door* floating on the water. Behind it lives a whole **household**: grandma on a lilo, dad on a duck, three kids and a goldfish. They invite him in for dinner, and the Hunter becomes the seventh member of the **household**.

The {Lifeguard} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Yeti Cave} and finds a *lineup* of yetis warming their feet on glowing *embers*. The fire roars **intense**, so hot their fur starts to curl. The heat is so **intense** that the icicles melt into a hot bath, and the yetis put on sunglasses.

The {Yogi} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Hangar} as *water drops* rain from a leaky plane. A *sheep* is caught in the flood and starts to swim. The drops become a sea, then a whole **ocean**, and the sheep sails off across the **ocean** on a floating suitcase, waving goodbye.

The {Gardener} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Hut} watching his *elder brother* climb up with a ladder. His **elder brother** steals the gardener's watering can and waters the clouds. It rains, and the **elder brother** laughs, as big brothers do.

The {Sailor} sneaks into the {Basement} of the {Warehouse} following a *silk skein* that leads into the dark. He has **to search** every crate for the end of the thread. He finds a sock, a parrot, a lost grandma, and keeps on **searching** till dawn.

The {Hunter} skids down the {Staircase} of the {Pool} on a tea tray, his long *whiskers* flying. He's **reckless**: he cannonballs off the diving board, juggles flaming torches, and rides a duck backwards. The lifeguard shouts that he's **reckless**, and he waves his whiskers.

The {King} creeps into the {Basement} of the {Swan Pond} and lets out a great *yawn*. Out tumble coins, banknotes and gold bars: the royal **funds**, saved for a rainy day. The swans paddle up, scoop the **funds** into their wings and sail off to buy a speedboat, while the King yawns again and finds his purse empty.

The {King} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Tower} into a room where a *cow head* sips a cup of *coffee*. Too tired to stand, he tries **to lean on** the cow. The cow leans back, so they **lean on** each other and fall asleep.

The {Pirate} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Boxing Ring} and lies *flat* on the mat. A *small speech bubble* pops out of his mouth **to comment** on every punch: too slow, too fast, nice hat. The boxers stop fighting and **comment** on his comments.

The {Baker} creeps into the {Basement} of the {Mansion} and catches a *rebel* carving letters into a *wood slice* to print a secret newspaper. The Baker joins in and prints the next **edition** on slices of toast. The lord upstairs eats the news with butter, and every morning he demands a fresh **edition** with more jam.

The {Baker} sneaks into the {Basement} of the {Tower} and finds a *jade gem* hidden under the *roof* beam. It's **treasure**! He bakes it into a loaf to hide it, then forgets which loaf has the **treasure**, and has to eat a hundred.

The {Zookeeper} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Warehouse} into a *shed* where a *sitting pair* of elephants hog the only **seat**. He waits an hour, then perches on their trunks. Soon every worker wants a **seat**, so the elephants sell tickets and the forklift turns into a sofa with seatbelts.

The {Sheriff} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Beehive} and finds *animal tracks* all over the honey. He needs **to explain** who's been stealing it. He follows the tracks, stops, turns to the bees, and points his finger to **explain**: it was the bear, wearing slippers.

The {Juggler} hides in the {Basement} of the {Boxing Ring} and finds a painted *landscape* on the wall: mountains, rivers, cows. He steps into it and the **scenery** comes to life, the cows moo, the rivers flow. The boxers come down to admire the **scenery**.

The {Gardener} slips through the {Trapdoor} of the {Pool} and finds a *trapped man* under a *page* of instructions. The page says: please **look after** him. The Gardener feeds him, waters him like a plant, and promises **to look after** him forever.

The {Dentist} pops out of the {Trapdoor} on the {Beach} and his *little brother* bursts out after him, waving a spade. His **younger brother** buries him in the sand, draws a moustache on him, and steals his ice cream. The Dentist sighs: that's what a **younger brother** does.

The {Dentist} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Jungle} temple as a *climber* scrambles up the vines toward him. The climber wants **to climb** higher still, onto the Dentist's head, then onto a passing parrot. He loves **to climb** anything, even the Dentist's ladder of teeth.

The {Hunter} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Warehouse} and finds a *shape-shifter* turning into anything you want: a vase, a bike, a sofa. It pays with a *shell*. The Hunter fills his trolley with **goods**, and the shape-shifter turns into more **goods** to sell.

The {Hunter} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Pool} onto a floating *plank*, beside a *pig snout* that sniffs him. He sniffs back. They sniff each other, it's **mutual**. They trade hats, they trade sandwiches: everything is **mutual**, and they become best friends.

The {Firefighter} slides through the {Trapdoor} of the {Pool} and splashes down beside a *cashier* sitting on a lilo. The cashier hands her a bill: one hose, one helmet, one pool. She has **to pay**, so she sprays the cashier with gold coins. Now everyone wants **to pay** in water.

The {Baker} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Fort} and meets a *standing person* with a *white dove* on his head: it's his **uncle**. His **uncle** does magic tricks with the dove, pulls coins from the Baker's ears, and eats all the bread.

The {Magician} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Mansion} wearing a *long veil* that trails behind him. His *standing heart* beats very **slow**, so he walks very **slow**, one step every minute. The guests fall asleep waiting for his trick.

The {Ghost} floats onto the {Rooftop} of the {Boathouse}, unrolls a *district map* and gives a huge *yawn*. Out pours all of **Europe**: the Eiffel Tower, a Venetian gondola, a cuckoo clock, a wheel of cheese. The rowing boats bump into windmills, and the Ghost sails off on the gondola to tour **Europe** by moonlight.

The {Hunter} slides through the {Trapdoor} of the {Swan Pond}, and a *helping hand* grabs him for a *makeover*: pink wig, glitter boots, a feather boa. Horrified, he wants **to exchange** them for his old muddy coat. But the swans have put on his coat, and they refuse **to exchange** it back, strutting off looking very rugged.

The {Wizard} tiptoes up the {Staircase} of the {Funfair} and presses his *ear* to the creaky *gate* of the haunted house. He can **hear** the ghosts inside gossiping about him. Desperate **to hear** more, he grows his ear the size of an umbrella, and now he catches every whisper, every giggle, and every rollercoaster scream for miles.

The {Wizard} perches on the {Rooftop} of the {Lake} house and sees a *teetering man* balancing on the chimney. **Danger**! The man wobbles, the roof cracks, the lake bubbles. The Wizard yells **danger**, and casts a spell that gives the man wings.

The {Magician} races up the {Staircase} of the {Hangar} with his *standing heart* pounding. A *tombstone* stands at the top, carved: too **busy** to rest. He's so **busy**, pulling rabbits from hats, sawing ladies in half, that he forgets to have lunch.

The {Hunter} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Hut} and finds a *wild boar* chewing a peach under a *tree*. The boar spits out the **pit**, which shoots across the room and hits the Hunter on the nose. He plants the **pit**, and a tree grows instantly.

The {Ghost} slides through the {Trapdoor} of the {Mansion} and plays a sad *music* that makes the *sun* hide. The rooms go **dark**, the candles go out, and the guests bump into each other. The Ghost glows a little in the **dark**.

The {Juggler} hides in the {Basement} of the {Yeti Cave} until a *woman* on a *stepladder* climbs down: his **older sister**. She takes his juggling balls, she takes his snacks, and she bosses the yeti too, because she's the **older sister**.

The {Juggler} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Yeti Cave} and a *go-between* appears in a tuxedo. He loves **to introduce** people: Juggler, meet Yeti; Yeti, meet Juggler. He goes on **to introduce** the icicles, the snow and the yeti's mum.

The {Hunter} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Wine Cellar} onto a pile of *soil* where someone has planted a *no sign*. The wine has gone **bad**, the cheese is **bad**, the mice have **bad** manners. He holds his nose and runs.

The {Tailor} sneaks into the {Basement} of the {Tower} where a group raises a *thumb* every time a *small speech bubble* floats up. They want **to discuss** the dress code: top hats or not? They **discuss** for three days and decide on socks.

The {Lifeguard} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Beach} onto a rotten old *plank*. She paints it with shells, sunsets and glitter until it shimmers and becomes a **beautiful** surfboard. She rides it on the biggest wave of the year, and everyone on the sand drops their ice creams, it looks so **beautiful**.

The {Lifeguard} jogs up the {Staircase} of the {Stadium} carrying a *good meal* for the hungry football team. The soup is **good**, the bread is **good**, the dumplings are perfect. One bite and the players start playing **good** football, scoring ten goals, and the goalkeeper asks for second helpings in the middle of the match.

The {Shepherd} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Museum} into a *shed* full of statues, each with an *offering* bowl. He lines them up in **order**: smallest to tallest, oldest to youngest. The curator nods: the statues are in perfect **order**.

The {Sheriff} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Jungle} temple and pours *grass* seed onto a *slide*. The grass grows upward, the slide tilts, and everyone begins **to rise**: monkeys, parrots, the Sheriff. He keeps **rising**, waving to the clouds.

The {Juggler} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Yen Exchange} and an *inspector* with a clipboard watches every coin he juggles. The **inspector** is there **to supervise**, scribbling notes. The Juggler drops a coin, and the inspector frowns: he'll **supervise** even more closely.

The {Lifeguard} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Inn} and at the top meets a monster. She must **face** it, so she turns and stares it right in the eyes. The monster blinks first, embarrassed, and runs. Next time she has **to face** the bill.

The {Lifeguard} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Stadium} onto a *small table* with a lamp on it. She flicks it on, and the light is so **bright** it floods the whole pitch. The players put on sunglasses, the ball glows, the night is **bright** as day.

The {Lifeguard} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Pool} as heavy *rain* washes away the tiles of a garden *pathway*, **revealing** glinting gold coins underneath. She digs with her whistle and her bare hands **to reveal** more, and finally uncovers a secret door with a pirate behind it, who is very embarrassed to be found.

The {Yogi} meditates in the {Basement} of the {Lagoon} hut beside a *stream* that never stops flowing. He sits there **forever**: years pass, then centuries, and his beard grows down the stream to the sea. Fish build nests in it. The stream will run **forever**, and the Yogi has no plans to get up for lunch.

The {Hunter} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Pool} hut with a silver *whistle* in his *mouth*. He blows **to call** the swimmers in, and everyone leaps out of the water. Then the ducks waddle over, then the frogs, then a confused submarine. He keeps **calling** until half the town is standing around the pool, dripping.

The {Wizard} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Lake} house into the garden, where a huge *mouth* is chewing a *sapling*. Every leaf has a different **taste**: lemon, then chocolate, then soap. The Wizard nibbles one, and the **taste** is so strong his hat spins off and his beard turns the colour of mint ice cream.

The {Yogi} crawls into the {Basement} of the {Hut} and finds a whole *wilderness* inside: wolves, cacti, a waterfall. It's a **wild field** hidden under the hut. He meditates in the middle of the **wild field** while the wolves howl.

The {Juggler} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Piazza} and nails a *plus sign* onto a *tree*. It becomes a **frame**, and he hangs pictures on it: a cat, a pizza, his mum. The pigeons perch on the **frame** to pose.

The {Yogi} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Museum} into a patch of *soil* with a *guard post* at each corner. It's his own **region**: he plants a flag and declares it a country. The guards block anyone from entering his **region** without a ticket.

The {Sheriff} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Spa} as *sand* pours down from the sky. It fills the hot tubs, the saunas, the massage rooms. **Sand** in his boots, **sand** in his hat, and the guests build sandcastles in the pool.

The {Dentist} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Cat Café}, and a *helping hand* passes him a lit *beacon*. It's hot! He has **to drop** it, and it rolls under a sleeping cat. The cat wakes, and **drops** its milk.

The {King} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Warehouse} and a *helping hand* lays out a giant *tongue* like a carpet. He wants **to include** everything on it: crates, boxes, workers. The tongue wraps around them all, and **includes** the King too.

The {Juggler} plunges through the {Trapdoor} of the {Yen Exchange} and lands on the deck of a grey *boat* bristling with cannons. A *watcher* in the crow's nest shouts: enemy bankers ahead! It's a **warship**, steaming through the trading floor, firing paper money from its guns. The Juggler is promoted to admiral of the **warship** and salutes a calculator.

The {Yogi} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Museum} and finds a *fish* in a glass case, holding a sign: please do not tap. He taps. The **fish** leaps out, flops up the steps, and swims through the air past the dinosaurs. The visitors chase it with butterfly nets, and the Yogi teaches the **fish** to meditate on a marble pillar.

The {Zookeeper} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Spa} and finds a *bare tree* hung with everything imaginable. A *crowbar* pries open a cupboard and out falls more: towels, ducks, a trumpet, spaghetti. It's all **mixed** up, mud with bubbles, cucumbers with socks. The guests soak in a **mixed** bath of everything, and the trumpet plays itself.

The {Wizard} tumbles through the {Trapdoor} of the {Pool}, where a *loudmouth* is shouting a *small speech bubble* full of wrong directions. Following them, the Wizard dives into the snack bar instead of the water. **Mistake**! He casts a drying spell and turns the pool into jelly. Another **mistake**. The loudmouth gives him a thumbs-up.

The {Wizard} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Mansion} with a *bent bow* and fires *water drops* into the garden. Each arrow digs a curve in the lawn until the sea rushes in and fills it. Now the mansion has its own **bay**, with sailing boats and a lighthouse. The butler serves tea on a raft in the middle of the **bay**.

The {Juggler} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Beach} juggling a *lucky charm*: a golden four-leaf clover. Every time he catches it, something wonderful happens: he finds a coin, a seagull returns his hat, the sun comes out. It's his **lucky** day! He throws the charm to a crab, and the crab wins the lottery, looking very **lucky** indeed.

The {Juggler} sneaks into the {Basement} of the {Yen Exchange}, where *icicles* drip on piles of gold. He throws *salt* on them and they shrink, and so does the gold, coin by coin. The bankers watch their money **decrease**, and the Juggler keeps salting until even the price of bread starts **to decrease**.

The {Baker} perches on the {Rooftop} of the {Yen Exchange} with a long *silk thread* and an old *nameboard*. He begins **to weave** the thread around the board, over and under, until the bankers' names are stitched into a tapestry. He can't stop: he goes on **to weave** a hat, a jumper and a hammock for the pigeons.

The {Chef} crawls into the {Basement} of the {Pool}, where a tangled *grove* blocks the view. He rolls out a white *bolt of cloth* and wipes every leaf until the water sparkles. Now everything is **clear**: the bottom of the pool, a lost ring, a sleeping eel. The eel wakes, annoyed, but the view is perfectly **clear**.

The {King} sneaks into the {Basement} of the {Funfair}, where a *stop sign* blocks the ghost train. Under a full *moon* the sign suddenly flips: go! He's finally **willing**, he jumps into the carriage and screams all the way through. The ghosts are **willing** to give him a second ride, and even a free candyfloss.

The {Tsar} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Hut} into a puddle of *water drops* with a fat *rulebook* tucked under his arm. He has **to measure** everything: the drops, the hut, the cat's whiskers. He even tries **to measure** his own shadow, but it keeps running away whenever the ruler comes near.

The {Baker} crashes through the {Trapdoor} of the {Island} swinging a *cane* at an army of crabs, each armoured in a *shell*. Smack, smack, smack! He means **to defeat** them all and save his bread. One by one the crabs fall on their backs, legs waving, **defeated**, and surrender their claws as rolling pins.

The {Wizard} lands on the {Rooftop} of the {Pool} hut and finds a whole *cottage* built on top of it. With a flick of his wand, the **house** grows a chimney, a doorbell and a garden gnome. Swimmers queue at its front door for towels. The Wizard moves in, and the **house** floats when it rains.

The {Pirate} sneaks into the {Basement} of the {Tower} and finds a *parcel* that suddenly sprouts a *kicking foot*. It kicks him in the shin and starts **to run**, leaping up the stairs. The Pirate chases it round and round the tower, and they both **run** until the parcel bursts open: it's full of trainers.

The {Magician} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Jungle} into a misty *grove* under a *dusk moon*. He falls asleep and has a **dream**: the trees play violins, the monkeys float like balloons, his hat swallows the moon. He wakes up and the monkeys are still floating. Was it a **dream**, or is the jungle dreaming him?

The {Sailor} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Mansion} clutching a sack of *scattered seeds*, and the sack bursts. Seeds bounce across the ballroom, under the piano, into the soup. A flock of pigeons swoops in and the guests **scatter**, screaming. The pigeons **scatter** too, and so does the orchestra, still playing.

The {Wizard} lands on the {Rooftop} of the {Funfair} holding a *warm bowl* of soup that steams into the cold night. *Water drops* condense on the roller coaster, which sighs happily. Everything turns **warm**: the dodgems, the candyfloss, the frozen clown. The Wizard ladles soup to the riders, and the whole funfair glows **warm** and cosy.

The {King} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Casino} and lands next to a *trapped tree* growing in a box. It can't get out, and neither can he: the box closes around them both. They're **trapped**! The King bets his crown, loses, and is still **trapped** with the tree, who's better at poker.

The {Juggler} tumbles through the {Trapdoor} of the {Yen Exchange} into an *assembly* of bankers, each brandishing a *standing knife*. He snatches the longest one: it's a **sword**! He juggles three swords at once, and the bankers flee. With a flourish of his **sword** he slices the stock prices in half.

The {Juggler} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Yen Exchange} next to a *chopping block*, where *water drops* fall one at a time. Drip, drip, drip, and **gradually** the block wears away. Year by year it gets smaller, and the bankers watch **gradually** turn into eventually, until only a splinter is left.

The {Firefighter} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Jungle} temple holding a *jade tablet* and presses her *thumb* onto a pot of red wax. She must **seal** the temple's secret scroll. She stamps it so hard the wax fuses shut. The monkeys try to open it, but it stays **sealed** forever.

The {Juggler} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Youth Hostel} and hooks a drowning cat out of the bath with his *cane*. He wraps it in a *fur coat* and rubs it dry. He has managed **to save** it! The cat purrs, then calls its friends, and the Juggler has **to save** forty more.

The {Gardener} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Waiting Room} and finds a cup of coffee with a giant *price tag*: one million dollars. It's **expensive**! The magazines are **expensive**, the chairs are **expensive**, even the air is charged by the breath. He holds his breath and runs out.

The {Cheerleader} high-kicks on the {Rooftop} of the {Stadium} and accidentally knocks a *tree* through the roof of a *barn*. Out falls an old **gun** filled with confetti. She fires it at the crowd: bang! Glitter everywhere. The referee grabs the **gun** and fires it at the ceiling, starting the match.

The {Cheerleader} spins across the {Rooftop} of the {Ice Rink} with a *clay jar* that's missing a chunk, and an *archer's ring* that doesn't fit any finger. The team **lacks** a captain, the jar **lacks** a lid, and she **lacks** a skate. She keeps cheering anyway: what do we **lack**? Everything!

The {Lifeguard} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Boathouse} and finds a *tree* wearing a *tall bun* of hair. The bun keeps growing, storey after storey, until it becomes a **building** with windows and lifts. Ducks rent the top floor, and the **building** sways in the breeze.

The {Shepherd} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Yen Exchange}, and a *stepladder* unfolds under his *elbow*. From the top he can see the whole **county**: farms, sheep, towns. He declares himself mayor, and the bankers give him the **county** keys.

The {Sheriff} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Hangar} and climbs into the dusty *attic*. Everything there is **still** there: his old cowboy boots, his first hat, a jar of sweets. Even his childhood horse is **still** waiting, and it neighs hello.

The {Hunter} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Tower} carrying one single hair of *fur* as a trophy. It weighs a **tiny bit**, smaller than an eyelash. He displays it on a velvet cushion. The guests peer at it with a magnifying glass, seeing only a **tiny bit** of fluff.

The {Yogi} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Beach} carrying a *grain stalk*, and over *many moons* he begins **to move** the whole beach. Grain by grain, shell by shell, he shifts it to the next bay. The crabs help him **move** the sea too.

The {Ninja} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Stadium} and finds a *woman* serving a *good meal* to the whole football team. She's everyone's **mother**: she wipes their noses, ties their shoelaces, and scolds the referee. The Ninja gets a hug from the **mother** too.

The {Pirate} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Jungle} arm in arm with his two *buddies*, a monkey and a parrot. They share bananas, sing sea shanties and swing through the vines together. A tiger joins, and the Pirate has a new **friend**. Even the snakes want to be his **friend**.

The {Hunter} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Water Park} with a *plank* as his easel. He loves **to draw**: he draws a slide, and it becomes real; he draws a wave, and it splashes. He decides **to draw** a shark, then rubs it out quickly.

The {Baker} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Mansion} and teaches a **class** of bread rolls with *twin jades* as their teachers. The rolls raise their crusts to answer questions. The jades give gold stars, and the whole **class** graduates as croissants.

The {Jockey} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Beehive} and meets a *sage* polishing the *sun* with his beard. The bees bring him questions, and he answers each one with great **wisdom**: buzz less, make more honey. The Jockey asks how to win the race, and the sage's **wisdom** says: ride faster.

The {Yogi} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Beach} and lands beside a *sweating man* copying everything he does. The Yogi bends; the man **also** bends. The Yogi stands on his head; the man **also** stands on his head. Soon the crabs, the seagulls and the setting sun are **also** doing yoga, all dripping with sweat.

The {Ghost} floats into the {Basement} of the {Car Park} and finds a giant *ear* lying across three parking spaces. It hears every engine, every honk, every whisper. The Ghost whispers boo into the **ear**, and the **ear** jumps so high it hits the ceiling.

The {Ghost} floats onto the {Rooftop} of the {Funfair} and gives the shivering clown a *warm hug*. The clown is so touched by such **kindness** that he hands out free balloons to every child. The **kindness** spreads, and the carousel horses hug each other.

The {Dentist} sneaks into the {Basement} of the {Swan Pond} with an *arrow* and a *bean* to measure the swans. The arrow is **short**, the bean is even **shorter**, and he's pretty **short** himself. The swans stretch their long necks and laugh. In the end the tape measure shrinks in shame and becomes **short** too.

The {Jockey} sneaks into the {Basement} of the {Hangar}, where a giant *palm* sticks up out of the floor. He sits in the **palm**, and it lifts him up like a lift. It waves him around, then high-fives a plane with its **palm**.

The {King} creeps into the {Basement} of the {Lagoon} hut, where a metal *brace* is clamped round a trembling *heart*. He's **afraid**: of the dark, of the crabs, of the sound of water. The heart shakes so much the brace pops off, and the King is too **afraid** to pick it up.

The {Yogi} strolls up the {Staircase} of the {Beach} and drops a *price tag* on the sandy *road*. Then he forgets his sandals, his towel, his snacks and finally his own shadow, **leaving behind** a trail all the way to the sea. The seagulls collect everything he has **left behind** and open a second-hand shop.

The {Gardener} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Pool} and builds a *fence* around an *antique* vase. The fence is **solid**, unbreakable, made of iron and glue. The swimmers bounce off it, the sharks bump it, but it's **solid**, and the vase stays perfectly safe.

The {Shepherd} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Beach} and lays down his *towel* on the hot sand to save a **seat**. The sheep do the same, a hundred towels, a hundred seats. No space left for the crabs, who must take a **seat** on the Shepherd's head.

The {Sailor} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Lagoon} hut looking down at a *tree* in the *town square*. Its roots are **loose**, its leaves **loose**, its trousers **loose**. It wobbles and wanders off down the street. The Sailor ties it up again, but the knot is **loose** too.

The {Magician} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Beach}, where a *pinned heart* hangs on a *grain stalk*, whispering a **secret**. He listens carefully, but it won't tell. He does a trick and the **secret** pops out: the sea is actually lemonade.

The {Shepherd} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Yeti Cave} and an *archer* saves him from a yeti. A *small speech bubble* pops out of his mouth **to thank** him: thank you, thanks, cheers! He doesn't stop **thanking** him, even after the archer goes home.

The {Lifeguard} sneaks into the {Basement} of the {Pool}, where a *fish* is eating a slice of the *sun*. It burps, slurps, and wipes its fins on the curtains. It's so **crass**: it spits, it yells, it wears socks in the pool. The Lifeguard blows her whistle at the **crass** fish.

The {Yogi} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Museum} and walks down a *road*, when he happens **to meet** a *monkey* in a top hat. They bow, shake hands, and go for tea. He goes on **to meet** a mummy, a dinosaur, and the museum's ghost.

The {King} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Hangar} eating a bowl of *rice husk*. It's so **healthy**: he flexes his muscles, he does push-ups, he lifts a plane. All the pilots eat husks too and become **healthy** enough to fly without engines.
